info.name: SMS OTP Country Restriction - snapshot rollouts
info.description: Reads the active RiderConfig / TransporterConfig rollouts before the auth suite runs. run-tests.sh exports the environment so RestoreSmsOtpRollouts can put them back after the suite, whether it passed or failed.

exec: var d = null; try { d = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {}
pm.test('RiderConfig rollout read', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(Array.isArray(d), 'response is a JSON array').to.eql(true); });
var isTest = function (x) { return (x.versionDescription || '').indexOf('Integration test SMS OTP country restriction') === 0; };

var live = (Array.isArray(d) ? d : []).map(function (r) { return {domain: r.domain, timeBounds: r.timeBounds, rollout: (r.rollout || []).filter(function (x) { return !isTest(x); }).map(function (x) { return {rolloutPercentage: x.rolloutPercentage, version: x.version, versionDescription: x.versionDescription || 'restored'}; })}; });
var restore = live.length > 0 ? live : [{domain: domain, timeBounds: 'Unbounded', rollout: []}];
// A failed read must not produce a snapshot: restoring from it would wipe live rollouts.

if (pm.response.code === 200 && Array.isArray(d)) { pm.environment.set('_sms_rider_rollout_snapshot', JSON.stringify(restore)); console.log('RiderConfig rollout snapshot:', JSON.stringify(restore)); }
var d = null; try { d = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {}
pm.test('TransporterConfig rollout read', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(Array.isArray(d), 'response is a JSON array').to.eql(true); });
var isTest = function (x) { return (x.versionDescription || '').indexOf('Integration test SMS OTP country restriction') === 0; };

var live = (Array.isArray(d) ? d : []).map(function (r) { return {domain: r.domain, timeBounds: r.timeBounds, rollout: (r.rollout || []).filter(function (x) { return !isTest(x); }).map(function (x) { return {rolloutPercentage: x.rolloutPercentage, version: x.version, versionDescription: x.versionDescription || 'restored'}; })}; });
var restore = live.length > 0 ? live : [{domain: domain, timeBounds: 'Unbounded', rollout: []}];
// A failed read must not produce a snapshot: restoring from it would wipe live rollouts.

if (pm.response.code === 200 && Array.isArray(d)) { pm.environment.set('_sms_driver_rollout_snapshot', JSON.stringify(restore)); console.log('TransporterConfig rollout snapshot:', JSON.stringify(restore)); }
